text:
maria.s: SCIM sync failing for ~120 users since the RBAC change on Monday. IdP returning 403 for many entitlements, SCIM audit shows 'missing email' and SAML response contains no NameID. Anyone seen this?

sam.k: checking logs — SCIM svc shows `InvalidPrincipal: SAML assertion missing NameID` and in audit stream there's `KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED` for attribute decryption.

security-oncall: possible KMS key rotation mismatch. @alex.p did we rotate the KMS key for idp encryption last week?

alex.p: yes, rotated alias/rdw-idp-encrypt on 2026-03-18 (1779410000). I updated backend but looks like the idp metadata still references the old key thumbprint.

jordan.r: also saw terraform PR #542 accidentally broadened group->role mapping: `group: infra-owners` -> `role: admin` (should be `write`). rolling that back now.

maria.s: rolling RBAC revert now. will pause any SCIM writes until we confirm mappings.

ashley.c: immediate mitigation: disable SCIM provisioning write access from the IdP, enable verbose audit + webhook forwarding to sec-logs for full event capture (90d retention).

security-oncall: next steps: 1) re-issue SAML cert and publish updated metadata to IdP 2) ensure KMS key policy includes idp-service-account and allow decrypt 3) run SCIM sync with `--dry-run` 4) add alerts for `DECRYPT_FAILED` and repeated `SCIM 403` errors.

maria.s: pasted sanitized SAML snippet:
```
<samlp:Response ...>
  <saml:Assertion Encrypted="true">...Encrypted data...</saml:Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

sam.k: after updating idp metadata and key policy, dry-run shows zero missing-claim errors. SCIM create/update would have succeeded.

maria.s: making an incident ticket and vuln-triage entry. Assigning: eng-infra for KMS policy, identity for SAML metadata, platform for RBAC guardrails, and security for audit alerts.

maria.s: I'll post the ticket link shortly. Thanks all :thumbsup:
